From: Sam Wells <sam.wells@veloxai.com>

Cc: Ops Team <ops@veloxai.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Intermittent 503s during peak — request for SLO compensation?

Hi Marissa,

We saw a spike of 503s hitting our production endpoints yesterday during our peak window (2026-10-11 17:30–18:05 PDT). Impact: roughly 3% of requests returned 503 at p95 for ~35 minutes, and our app experienced cascading retries. This materially affected our customer experience and month-end metrics.

Can you confirm whether this maps to an SLO breach under our agreement and outline next steps for credit/compensation? We can provide request IDs, traces, and a short video of the dashboard spike. Finance is asking for an estimate before month-end billing.

Attaching a zip of screenshots and a short list of request IDs we captured.

Thanks,
Sam Wells
Head of Platform
Velox AI

Attachments: velox_503_screenshots.zip, sample_request_ids.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ops Team <ops@veloxai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during peak — request for SLO compensation?

Hi Sam,

Thanks for flagging and for the captures — I’ve started an internal investigation and looped in Karthik (sales/finance) and Tessa (AM) to help coordinate. Initial asks so our SRE team can validate the window: 1) a short list of representative request IDs (you included some — great), 2) any client-side timestamps and retry patterns, and 3) whether you saw any traffic rerouting (region-specific).

We’ll validate whether the incident meets the SLO definition (availability window vs. maintenance exclusions) and return a preliminary credit eligibility assessment by EOD PT. If it’s helpful, we’ll also produce a raw request-id log export and a concise timeline you can share with finance.

I’ll open a formal incident (INC-9876) and share the SRE point-of-contact once they triage.

Short timeline:
- Today: Triage + window validation (SRE)
- 2–3 business days: Credit calculation and tentative number
- 7 business days: Postmortem (root cause + remediation)

Is it okay for us to share the findings with your finance team and billing contact?

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Tessa —

I’ll take ownership of the credit assessment side. Quick notes on process so the Velox team knows what to expect:
1) We’ll confirm the exact incident window from service-side metrics (availability vs. maintenance exclusions).
2) Credit is calculated pro-rata for the affected SLO period per section 4.2 of the MSA. If the window qualifies, we’ll provide a preliminary dollar estimate and token/usage offset.
3) To compute accurately we need the sample request IDs (they provided a list) + any tracing ids you can share. If Velox prefers, we can run our model against their ingestion logs to estimate retry amplification — please authorize sharing to billing@redwood.com.

I’ve attached a one-page template that speeds up the credit calc (credit-calculation-template.csv). If finance needs the number by tomorrow, we’ll prioritize it but it will be a preliminary estimate until SRE validates the exact downtime.

2) If eligible, Revenue Ops (Karthik) will calculate a provisional credit amount and provide a written estimate to share with your finance team by EOD PT.

I’ll keep everyone posted in this thread. If you need the preliminary number faster, call me directly at +1 (415) 555-0142.
